title: Private Salon Fitting & Champagne Reception Protocol
summary: Mandatory setup guidelines for welcoming Diamond & Platinum UHNW clients in boutique private salons.
content: Private salon reservations must be confirmed at least 2 hours prior to arrival. Ensure client's preferred vintage (Dom Pérignon 2013 or Krug Grande Cuvée) is chilled to 8°C. Requested haute horology and jewelry items must be transferred from the vault to the presentation tray prior to seating.

title: Global Tax-Free Shopping & Cross-Border VAT Refund
summary: Tax-free export processing for international visitors across Paris, London, New York and Tokyo boutiques.
content: Non-resident clients purchasing items exceeding $5,000 qualify for immediate digital export validation via Global Blue VIP Concierge. In-salon passport scanning is supported. Explain that luxury goods must remain sealed in security packaging until departure airport customs validation.

title: GIA & Haute Joaillerie Diamond Allocation Verification
summary: Protocol for verifying digital GIA dossiers and micro-laser inscriptions on high jewelry stones.
content: All solitaire diamonds above 2.0 carats carry micro-laser inscribed GIA dossier codes on the girdle. Use the high-resolution salon loupe camera to project the inscription onto the client table tablet for full transparency during the consultation.

title: Bespoke Horology Allocation & Waiting List Policy
summary: Rules governing allocation approvals for grand complications, minute repeaters, and limited perpetual calendars.
content: Grand complication allocations require approval from the Regional Managing Director. Clients with >$250k annual spend receive Tier 1 allocation priority. Never quote definite delivery timeframes for hand-engraved Geneva pieces without atelier supervisor confirmation.
